terms.gloss: unworthy, undeserving (+ ablative); of things, undeserved, shameful
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 5.46: dīvitiās quīvīs quamvīs indignus, habēre potest (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: jacēs indignō quanta rēs, inquit, locō!
phrases.english: what a fine thing you are, he said, to be lying in so unworthy a place!

phrases.latin: dīvitiās quīvīs quamvīs indignus, habēre potest
phrases.english: anyone at all, however undeserving, can have riches

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
